facts.statement: Reflect Healthcare pharmacy spaces typically take around 600, 800, or sometimes even 300 square feet.
facts.quote: I think pharmacy takes around 600, 800, or sometimes even 300 square feet.

facts.statement: DMart Minimax stores are operated on a lease basis.
For ready-built properties, the company does a valuation when the store opens and splits the cost based on a valuation certificate into land and building.
facts.quote: So, in a ready-built property, what we do is we do a valuation of the property when the store opens and then we split the cost based on the valuation certificate into land and building.
